about

Building at the edge of
hardware and software.

I'm a driven tech enthusiast with a strong foundation in software development and embedded systems. I like building things that connect the physical world to code — whether that's a camera module reading its surroundings or a script parsing the result.

My long-term goal is to go deep into DevOps — I'm drawn to the discipline of automating, deploying and scaling systems reliably, and I'm building my fundamentals in programming, databases and cloud tooling with that direction in mind.

projects

What I'm working on.

Smart Blind Stick

Mar 2026 — Jun 2026

A smart assistance system that helps visually impaired users identify objects in their surroundings in real time. An ESP32-CAM captures a live video feed, a YOLO-based detection model identifies objects in the frame, and the result is read back to the user through text-to-speech — turning a camera into a spoken description of the world ahead.

  • Integrated ESP32-CAM for real-time image capture
  • Implemented YOLO-based object detection
  • Added voice output to communicate detected objects
